---
title: "brant"
description: "Test for the parallel regression assumption in ordinal logit models (co-authored with Benjamin Schlegel)."
order: 1
---

**What it does.** Tests the parallel regression assumption (Brant 1990) for
ordinal logit models fitted with `polr()` from the `MASS` package. Developed
with Benjamin Schlegel.

**Installation**

```r
install.packages("brant")
```

**Links:** [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=brant) ·
[Package website](https://benjaminschlegel.ch/r/brant/) ·
[Brant (1990)](https://doi.org/10.2307/2532457)
